_comment: Declarative set of context artifacts the workflow sends to Monocle at review gates (DX-jn-8-017). 'roles' define each artifact's path + stable id + syntax type; 'contexts' list which roles to send for a given review step. Stable ids (e.g. plan:{ID}) make re-sends UPDATE in place instead of accumulating. Consumed by .claude/scripts/monocle-review.sh. {ID} = TODO id; {plan} = the TODO's plan: frontmatter path.
